steps.title: Prepare the site
steps.why: Clear, level and set out the footprint so the foundation lands where the drawing says.

steps.title: Foundation
steps.why: Everything else stands on it; it must cure before loads go on.

steps.title: Ground floor slab
steps.why: Walls are set out and fixed on the slab, so it comes before any wall.

steps.title: Walls and frame
steps.why: Walls carry the roof; no roof without them.

steps.title: Roof
steps.why: Closes the building against weather before any interior work starts.

steps.title: Windows and doors
steps.why: Makes the inside dry and secure for services and finishes.

steps.title: Wiring, pipes and ducts (rough-in)
steps.why: Runs inside walls and floors, so it goes in before boards close them.

steps.title: Insulation and wallboards
steps.why: Closes the walls over the inspected services.

steps.title: Floors, tiles and paint
steps.why: Last wet and dusty trades before clean fixtures go in.

steps.title: Kitchens, bathrooms and fittings
steps.why: Fitted on finished surfaces so they are not damaged.

steps.title: Test and hand over
steps.why: Electrical, water and ventilation tested before anyone moves in.

finishes_map.note: finish by room type (wet rooms tiled); +10% waste not included

pipe_m.basis: 109 wet fixtures from the deep read, branches to 4 wing mains, orthogonal runs + 30% routing allowance (estimate, no plumbing sheet)

loading_units.basis: EN 806-3 loading units: washbasin 1, WC cistern 1, shower 2, bath 4, kitchen sink 2 (supply pipe sizing starts from this total)

waste_flow_ls.basis: EN 12056-2: Qww = K x sqrt(sum DU) = 0.7 x sqrt(130.4) (discharge units: WC 2.0, washbasin 0.5, shower 0.6, bath 0.8; K = 0.7 frequent use)

cable_m.basis: room-to-room circuit tree from a panel near the building centre over 52 rooms, +30% routing (circuits per HD 60364 / IEC 60364; cross-sections not sized here)

lights.basis: lumen method N = E x A / (lumens x UF x MF) per room, E from EN 12464-1 by room type (corridors 100 lx, rooms / bathrooms 200, gym 300, common / study 500), 1500 lm LED, UF 0.6, MF 0.8

sockets.basis: planning rule in the style of DIN 18015-2 (room <= 8 m2: 2, <= 12: 3, <= 20: 4, then +1 per 10 m2); check the national standard
